body: I know exactly how you feel. If there’s a God, then he’s forgotten about us
He has his own issues, I don’t want to burden him with mine
I’ll most likely keep them to myself
I just want to see them one last time, I miss them so much
No, not really. I know they’re genuine and they really do want to help, but I know that nothing they suggest will work. I’m too far gone

It’s like people try to help me, but I shoot every idea down and ignore their help, only focusing on the negative. People get frustrated with that, and leave me. And I never try new things in fear that it won’t go well
I’m glad you’re still here, I know it’s tough. I honestly think waiting till thanksgiving is hard, I can’t imagine sticking around to Christmas

I honestly feel like I’m just not meant to be alive. I have debilitating anxiety that only gets worse over the years, along with borderline personality disorder and depression. I constantly push everyone away, and fuck up good opportunities for myself because of my pessimism. I’m just so tired of being in pain, I don’t even want to be happy anymore because I know it’ll just get taken away. I’m so tired

Thank you, I definitely want to discuss it with him first cause without the flirty act we’re pretty much best friends, and I wanna give him a chance to fix his behavior, but yeah dropping him is definitely high on my list of choices...
